items.title: DiaMedica shares signs that drug extends pregnancy in fetal growth restriction trial
items.excerpt: DiaMedica Therapeutics has shared phase 2 results in severe early-onset fetal growth restriction, reporting that most participants with known delivery dates remained pregnant longer than expected.

items.title: FDA signs off on Siemens Healthineers next gen multiple sclerosis blood test

items.title: Sanofi inks massive $41B Insmed buyout for post-Dupixent growth drivers
items.excerpt: Sanofi has struck a deal to acquire Insmed for $41 billion, securing three commercial and late-phase respiratory assets to offset Dupixent’s looming loss of exclusivity.

items.title: Exicure expands work into Parkinson’s with X-CUE smart glasses
items.excerpt: Exicure is partnering with NeuroQ Biologics and the South Korean medtech company Laonz to expand its business into medical device technologies designed to assist patients with Parkinson’s disease.

items.title: Menopause can speed up brain ageing — hormone therapy might protect it
items.excerpt: Studies are revealing how menopause can also affect the progression of Alzheimer’s disease.

items.title: AI is ‘the end of mathematics as we know it’ — where does the field go next?
